claims.quote: Egg on a string CXR Transposition of the great arteries

claims.text: Aspects (abnorm in red) ♡: CT ratio <50% on PA (<60% on AP); contour
claims.quote: C - Cardiac: CT ratio <50% on PA (<60% on AP); contour; valves; pacemaker leads.
claims.locator: Chest X-Ray (CXR), Reading Approach (RIPE technical adequacy → ABCDE-FGHI)

claims.text: CXR: the ♡ shadow may have the classic egg-on-a-string appearance w a narrow upper mediastinum; the ECG shows Rt axis deviation and RVH but may be norm for a neonate
claims.quote: On chest x-ray, the cardiac shadow may have the classic egg-on-a-string appearance with a narrow upper mediastinum. ECG shows right axis deviation and right ventricular hypertrophy but may be normal for a neonate.

claims.text: Eti d-TGA: the aorta arises from the Rt ventricle and the pulm a. from the Lt ventricle, giving indep pulm and systemic circulations
claims.quote: In dextro-transposition of the great arteries (d-TGA), the aorta arises from the right ventricle and the pulmonary artery arises from the left ventricle, resulting in independent pulmonary and systemic circulations.

claims.text: Incompatible w life unless the circulations mix thru an atrial and/or ventricular septal opening or a patent ductus
claims.quote: d-TGA is incompatible with life unless mixing of the circulations occurs through an atrial and/or ventricular septal opening, or a patent ductus.

claims.text: Sx Severe cyanosis w.in hrs of birth, rapidly followed by met acidosis; ⍉murmurs unless other anomalies are present
claims.quote: Severe cyanosis occurs within hours of birth, followed rapidly by metabolic acidosis; there are no murmurs unless other anomalies are present.

claims.text: Tx and next step Her chart: prostaglandin E1; surg (arterial switch)
claims.locator: Chest X-Ray (CXR), Pediatric / Congenital CXR Signs table

claims.text: Relieve cyanosis w prostaglandin E1 to keep the ductus arteriosus open, and sometimes a balloon cath to enlarge the foramen ovale
claims.quote: Relieve cyanosis by giving prostaglandin E1 infusion to keep the ductus arteriosus open and sometimes by using a balloon catheter to enlarge the foramen ovale.

claims.text: Definitive repair: the arterial switch (Jatene) operation, typically in the first wk of life; survival after surg > 95%
claims.quote: Definitive repair of d-TGA is the arterial switch (Jatene) operation, typically done during the first week of life. The proximal portions of the great arteries are transected, the coronary arteries are transplanted to the native pulmonary root, which will become the neoaortic root, the aorta is connected to the left ventricle, and the pulmonary artery is connected to the right ventricle. Survival rate after surgery is > 95%.
